desc: Parse input N and string S.
Identify all indices $k$ where the count of W equals count of B in $S[1..k]$. Store these as valid cut points.
Initialize an array `A` of size $N+1$ with zeros.
Check if vertex index $2j$ is a valid cut point (i.e., $W_{2j} == B_{2j}$).
If yes, compute $A[j] = j! - \sum_{k=1}^{j-1} A[k] \times (j-k)! \pmod P$.
